Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: At least one evaluable conclusion contradicts the originally recorded results. Specifically, the Past Tense experiment claims token lens achieves ~65% accuracy, but the actual recorded result is 85.38% - a discrepancy of ~20 percentage points. Additional discrepancies include: (1) Capital Cities raw claim (~47%) vs actual (39.33%), (2) Family Relations concept claim (~60%) vs actual (51.58%), (3) Present Participle token claim (~60%) vs actual (68.28%). While qualitative conclusions (which lens performs best for semantic vs grammatical tasks) remain valid, the specific numerical claims do not match the recorded data.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All plan steps appear in the implementation. The methodology section specifies 5 steps: (1) Build concept/token lenses from OV matrices - implemented in get_ov_sum(), (2) Extract word embeddings via model forward pass - implemented in proj_onto_ov(), (3) Parallelogram arithmetic - implemented in get_parallelogram_scores(), (4) Compare four settings (raw, concept, token, all) with k=80 - implemented in all_parallelograms.py, (5) Effective rank analysis - implemented in parallelogram_ranks.py. All 6 planned experiments (Capital Cities, Family Relations, Present Participle, Past Tense, Word2Vec 14 categories, Effective Rank Analysis) have results in the cache directory.
